name: Harmony 350, the final test setup with event 0xFF bound
description: todo-compile-350 5.3, on the Harmony 350. The remote holds lab work/setups/h350-test/from-nothing-5.4.bin, 124170 bytes: the whole test setup built with no Logitech file as input, eight devices on the four device keys' short and long presses, Watch TV with the LG TV's and the Denon's inputs and its flag, the five favourite channels 1, 2, 3, 666 and 07 on the KPN, and, since 5.4, firmware event 0xFF bound in the key table to the list event 0x30 runs, decision 28. packages/bench/test/harmony-300-350/final53.test.ts derives every step's expectation from that file. A Harmony 350 never raises event 0xFF, so the entry is predicted to change nothing heard: these are the steps of 350-5-1-6-from-nothing.json, which heard 33 of 33, but for step 4, which presses Exit where that test pressed Enter, so that 300-5-3-final.json, the same steps on the Harmony 300, presses only keys a Harmony 300 has been heard to send. Predicted per step: 1 the LG TV's own VolumeUp and Info, a television keeping its volume; 2 the Knoll chosen, the Denon's VolumeUp and the Knoll's Timer on Up, from infrared group 4; 3 the Plasma's own VolumeUp and Menu; 4 Kodi chosen, the Denon's VolumeUp and Kodi's Exit, from group 5; 5 the Denon's VolumeUp and Info; 6 the Switch chosen, the Denon's VolumeUp and the Switch's Input1 on 1, from group 6; 7 the KPN chosen, the Denon's VolumeUp and the KPN's ChannelPrev; 8 the Sony HT chosen, the Denon's VolumeUp and its Stop, from group 7; 9 the Plasma's PowerOn and then its PowerOff, its power variable starting at off as the file seeds it, so the other way round means the remote kept another state; the PowerOff waits out the Plasma's 5 s power on delay; 10 Watch TV from everything off: the LG TV's PowerOn, the Denon's power on (code 26 of this file), the KPN's PowerToggle, and then the Denon's CBL/SAT input, held back by the Denon's 2 s power on delay; the LG TV's HDMI 1 sends nothing; wait about fifteen seconds before the next step; Watch TV leaves the remote in the KPN's mode; 11 channels 1, 2 and 3, one KPN digit each (codes 36, 37 and 38); 12 channel 666, the KPN's 6 (code 41) three times about a third of a second apart, which the monitor may show as one press with repeats; 13 channel 07, the KPN's 0 and then its 7 (codes 35 and 42); 14 the KPN's Channel Up and its 1 (codes 13 and 1); 15 Watch TV again: the LG TV's PowerOff, the Denon's power off (code 27) and the KPN's PowerToggle, and no input. The KPN's digits and the Denon's power codes are expected by their number in this file, since the catalogue gives each name to two codes of the device. The remote is predicted to keep answering through all 15 steps with no battery pull. A long press is held until the device key flashes; let go earlier it counts as a short press, and the step then sends the short press device's codes: repeat the step and note it. The favourite keys are the five numbered 1 to 5 around Input: 1 and 5 beside it, 2, 3 and 4 below it.

steps.instruction: Long press TV/Media → Volume Up → Up
Long press Cable/PC → Volume Up → Exit
Long press DVD/Music → Volume Up → Stop
